metadata.description: Trove gives your AI agents a library they can actually read. Install the Cowork plugin to research your own PDFs and markdown documents with page-level citations, browse and subscribe to marketplace books, and write knowledge documents back to your library — all over a hosted MCP server, with no local CLI to install.

plugins.name: trove-cowork
plugins.description: AI agent access to your Trove document library in Claude Cowork. Bundles the trove skill, four specialist sub-agents (librarian, item-reader, book-writer, book-enricher) and the hosted Trove MCP connector, so research, marketplace subscriptions and document writing all work with no local CLI or filesystem.
